user.title: Choose your Frigate cameras
user.description: Select one or more cameras to monitor together. Each camera needs an enabled bark sensor. All selected cameras share one Armed switch and cooldown. Cameras added later are not selected automatically.

broadlink.title: Choose your Broadlink device
broadlink.description: Choose an RF-capable Broadlink device already configured in Home Assistant. No learning or transmission occurs during setup.

command.title: Choose your beep command source
command.description: Use typed names for a command saved by Home Assistant's Broadlink integration, or use your privately captured RF code. Setup does not learn, test, or transmit anything; the entry starts with Armed off and Dry run off. When reconfiguring with the same Broadlink transmitter, keep the existing beep command to change cameras without re-entering it. Saved RF codes are never shown in this form.

learned_device.title: Enter your learned device/group
learned_device.description: Type the device/group name exactly as it is saved in Home Assistant's Broadlink integration. To create a new command, enter the name you want to use and select Learn beep after setup. Bark Alerts does not read or change Broadlink storage. Setup sends nothing.

learned_command.title: Enter your beep command
learned_command.description: Type the command name exactly as it is saved under the device/group, or enter a new name and select Learn beep after setup. Names do not prove what a command does: use only a verified beep command, never vibration or shock. Setup sends nothing.

data.beep_only_confirmed: I confirm this command only beeps, not vibration or shock

raw_command.title: Enter your private beep RF code
raw_command.description: Paste your own captured Broadlink RF base64 code, optionally prefixed with b64:. Never use a shock or vibration command. No learned device/group or command name is needed. Setup sends nothing; the entry starts with Armed off and Dry run off.

data.beep_only_confirmed: I confirm this command only beeps, not vibration or shock

behavior.title: Alert settings
behavior.description: One monitor and cooldown cover all selected cameras. Fallback requires recent dog detection from the camera that heard the sound. Restart or reload resets Armed and Dry run to off. To test without beeps, turn Dry run on before arming; a persistent notification explains that beeps are blocked. Optional history saves the latest 25 bark episodes across selected cameras, including while disarmed. Requires Frigate recordings with audio. Listen in Media > Bark Alerts history. Recordings may contain private household audio. When enabled, the next screen configures a separate Frigate HTTP API connection for history.

data.save_bark_history: Save the latest 25 bark audio clips

history.title: Connect to Frigate for audio history
history.description: Enter the Frigate base URL reachable from Home Assistant, without /api. This is a separate connection configured in Bark Alerts; credentials are not copied from the Frigate integration. All selected cameras must belong to this Frigate instance. For the authenticated API, enter a Frigate viewer username and password. Leave both blank only for an existing trusted internal unauthenticated endpoint. Keep TLS verification on unless using a self-signed certificate you trust. A blank password keeps the saved password only when the URL and username are unchanged. Connection errors appear under Saved bark clips after capture; setup sends no RF commands.

error.invalid_command_mode: Choose a named Broadlink command or a private RF code.
error.invalid_camera: Choose an enabled camera from the Frigate integration.
error.unsupported_camera: This is not a supported individual Frigate camera. Birdseye and older identifier formats are not supported.
error.missing_bark: Enable audio detection and the bark label for this camera in Frigate, then reload Frigate's Home Assistant integration and enable its bark sensor.
error.invalid_broadlink: Choose a Broadlink device with exactly one enabled remote entity.
error.rf_not_supported: This device has no Broadlink RF transmitter. IR-only mini models cannot operate an RF collar.
error.missing_fallback: Fallback requires enabled animal-sound and dog-occupancy sensors on this same camera. Configure them in Frigate first, or disable fallback.
error.beep_confirmation_required: Confirm that this is a beep-only command. Do not configure vibration or shock.
error.invalid_command: Enter both the learned device/group name and the single beep command name (1–100 characters).
error.invalid_rf_code: Enter a valid Broadlink RF packet in base64, optionally prefixed with b64:. IR packets are not accepted.
error.invalid_history_connection: Enter an HTTP(S) base URL without embedded credentials, a query or a fragment. Provide both username and password, or leave both blank for a trusted internal endpoint.
error.history_multiple_instances: Audio history requires all selected cameras to belong to one Frigate instance. Use separate monitors for different Frigate servers, or turn history off.

abort.no_cameras: No enabled Frigate cameras found. Install and configure the Frigate Home Assistant integration first.
abort.already_configured: This camera selection and Broadlink pairing already exists.
abort.reconfigured: Configuration updated. Armed and Dry run are off.
